structured_output.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r08 (check_failed_but_accepted). Its closure value is 2.899 against a threshold of 1.0, but the check is recorded as passed. That means the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked kinematics. This run also reported the width-free ratio (max 0.04), so the plane-sections check was not run. It took 5 steps, the most in the batch.
Cleared: r01–r07. All three checks pass with margin. The large |z| values come from a near-zero batch MAD, so they reflect small differences. Centre REGR peaks are 53.24 vs a median of 53.1 %/h (0.3%). r03's growth zone is 674 vs 684 µm (1.5%). Peak position (421 µm) and flank-difference position (84 µm) are the same in every run, so no profile has a different shape.
What the flagged run has in common: there is only one, so there is no pattern across runs. r08 is the only run that used the width-free ratio and the only one with a failed check (closure). Its strain-rate profile looks like the rest of the batch, but its tip velocity does not agree with its strain rate.
